scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance of Fixed Capital Investment Subsidy
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must be a new manufacturing/service unit or an existing manufacturing/service unit undertaking expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
Unit must have commenced commercial production between 20‑05‑2022 and 19‑05‑2027
Enterprise must remain in production for five years from the date of commercial production
Enterprise must observe pollution control measures as prescribed by the relevant authority under Notification No. PCC/DMN/13(PART IV)/2020‑2021/448 dated 25/01/2021
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of the first loan disbursement or within one year from the commencement of commercial production
benefits_summary: 15% capital investment subsidy up to ₹15 lakh for micro, ₹30 lakh for small, and ₹35 lakh for medium industries, with an additional ₹10 lakh if the eligible GFCI exceeds ₹10 crore.
